dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, no EXEC SQL/CICS.
evidence: COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters (GnuCOBOL style)
SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE01PARA / RECEERR (Linux file assignment style)
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly billing detail file creation for re-examination and self-pay receipts (再診・自費), point-count demand list editing
purpose.summary: ORCR0460 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It creates monthly business re-examination/self-pay receipt detail files and edits point-count demand lists. It reads indexed ISAM files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45, RECE46) and produces output including an error file.

notable_features: 17 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
Multiple INDEXED ISAM files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
Extensive Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
161 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
Revision history spanning 2000-2005 with named developers
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) and appear as mojibake under latin-1 decoding. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 136019 bytes (2946 lines total). The // REPLACING delimiter style is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. No COMP-3 is unusual for a financial system but consistent with ORCA codebase conventions.
